purpose: Preserve approved decisions and prevent accidental redesign; suggestions must reference current approved baseline.
rules: Approved decisions are the baseline; do not re-debate without new evidence, implementation constraints, or explicit user request.
When a topic recurs, show the existing decision, its rationale, status, and only genuinely new advice.
No change to approved scope or priority without explicit approval.
Record provenance and date of future decisions before marking them approved.
